composition: four discs bisecting two horizontal color fields
description: Four compact discs arranged in two horizontal pairs bisect a vertically striped composition divided into yellow-red upper and white-green lower fields. Each disc is halved by the color-field boundary, with iridescent silver undersides contrasting against dark resin-textured tops.
title: Four Discs, Two Fields
